market.summary: DR Congo (COD) has public universities, national/legal-deposit services, confessional institutions, specialist documentation centers and diplomatic/community reading services. Current national library/system totals are not available from this research. PMB is the best evidenced reusable public-catalog family in this feasibility sample; Koha is historically documented at UNIKIN/CEDESURK, and CD-ISIS is a documented predecessor at UPC. This is not LMS market share.
market.platform_strategy: Build a general PMB public-form/record/holding adapter with deployment profiles and strict institution mapping, then a separate CEPAS GET frontend adapter. Prioritize Mikanda shared-catalog institution mappings and SGN-C/IFRDC network profiles. Keep Koha as a secondary discovery/reactivation prospect until legitimate public endpoints can be verified. Preserve physical-book status and do not treat electronic databases, theses repositories or nominal catalog views as print holdings.

limitations: No national largest-ten ranking established;14 priorities are not a ranked size league table.
Seven observed successes: six selected candidates and one reserve; the ten-substantial-query goal remains four selected candidates short.
UDBL, SGN-C and IFRDC selection rests on explicit institutional/network proxies, not audited book totals; do not present them as the six largest libraries.
Only UPC/Karibuni are proven within Mikanda; CTCPM within SGN-C; IF Lubumbashi within IFRDC. Unqueried selectors do not establish holdings.
Historical counts, mixed book/ebook totals, periodicals and indexed notices are different units and must not be summed.

Normal anonymous sessions were memory-only; no accounts, cookies, authentication or reader actions were saved/performed. CSRF fields in bounded raw responses/request metadata are historical form evidence and must be freshly obtained.

One unsuccessful Mikanda UCC exploratory form/query/result chain did not enforce its 10-second crawl delay. Subsequent successful UPC sequence was corrected with explicit 10-second wait. This deviation is retained rather than represented as fully compliant.
UCC programme PDF was bounded to 2 MB of an 8 MB file and cannot validate its indexed 100,000-volume claim; use the complete 2015 primary paper for historical scale.
Public lookup is not permission to bulk reuse bibliographic databases; reader entry/borrowing rules and operational reliability need separate confirmation.
Research only: no product configuration, adapter, outreach or deployment changes; live_app_tested=false throughout.
